description: Use this when the user asks about dosing for a specific nutrient or supplement: typical daily intake ranges and upper limits from SuppCo's references, timing and whether to take it with food, plus a summary of its graded research. General information only; does not diagnose, treat or give personalized dosing advice. For what studies say about a supplement for a specific health area, use suppco_search_effects.

nutrient_name.description: The name of the nutrient or supplement (e.g., 'Vitamin D3', 'Magnesium', 'Fish Oil')
